title: 第21章 收益分成退出死亡空间第22章 重回死亡空间似曾相识
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
其实说起来，公司乃至员工，甚至李笑笑获得的能量，全都是孟天截留之后的剩余分成。
就如李笑笑，如果她获得十点能量，那么死亡空间将会截流五成，获得五点能量。
剩下的五点才是李笑笑的。
又因为她和孟天签订了契约，所以还会再和孟天平分五成。
李笑笑2.5点能量，孟天2.5点能量。
除此之外，构建公司规则，强化身体，交易买卖等等，孟天还会抽取相应的手续费。
而这其中，除了强化身体，算是作用自身，解封庞大的精神力量之外，其余在本质上全是作用于死亡空间。
嗯，作为死亡空间的员工，不将九成贡献给死亡空间怎么行？
若是李笑笑公司员工，还要被公司分五成，比起李笑笑更惨。
不过…
和进入死亡空间这样莫大的机缘相比，付出的那一点点能量，又能算得了什么呢？
嗯，就是如此！
孟天大点其头。
当然，这其中的一切，李笑笑都不知道，她只能看到她所获得的，以及以后员工所得。
在她的眼中，唯一的损耗，大概就是手续费了。
最多最多，也就是猜测出，她的收益会有一半分给孟天。
毕竟，她也是孟天的员工。
虽然契约上没写，但既然孟天是那主导契约之人，又怎么可能没有任何收益？
感受着脑海之中的信息，李笑笑沉默半晌，最终缓缓绕过办公桌，一屁股坐在办公椅上，感应着自身的状态。
又一股冥冥中的信息出现…

死亡空间的等级一共分为d、c、b、a、s五个等级，每个大的等级之间，又有三个小的等级。
比如d级，又分为d1、d2、d3级别，其它的依此类推。
而她目前的等级，正是最低级的d1级别，有着2点能量。
嗯，当她签完合同，彻底平静下来以后，力量再次掉落了一点，如今就只剩下2点能量了。
也是她最终的能量额度。
经过一番折腾之后，她终于从一点能量提升到了两点。
当达到4点能量的时候，她就是d2级别了，11点能量之上，就是c级。
而除了她本身的能量之外，自然就是公司拥有的能量了。
李笑笑伸手一招，两张卡片出现在了掌中。
这是能量卡，是孟天在和她签合同的时候，所生出的想法。
想要以能量交易买卖，自然需要具体的能量形式。
总不能，直接融入身体或者公司所在吧？
如此一来，交易的时候，还需要亲自接触，然后一点点的调动输送能量。
不但极为的麻烦，还可能会带上个人的精神印记杂念，吸收的多了，必然导致力量驳杂。
甚至因为作用的就是精神意识，还可能导致意识混乱，成为疯子或者精神分裂。
毕竟，可不是所有人都像孟天一样，有着死亡空间作为中转炼化。
而且他同化的，也只是纯粹的精神能量。
所以，孟天这才准备将所得能量，通过死亡空间的转化，洗去属于他人的情绪力量，个人精神印记以后，再分给其他人。
至于这些被剥离下来，残留在死亡空间的情绪力量、个人精神印记，也并不是毫无用途。
就如李笑笑先前对于电梯，对于小女孩，对于前台，乃至对于猛鬼大厦以及整个死亡空间的恐惧，都会融入相应的存在。

这会让它们，诞生一些属于恐惧元素的灵性力量，会对后来者内心产生一种恐惧威慑，继而攫取更多的精神力量。
至于对于死亡空间的污染…
content_en:
In fact, the energy gained by the company, employees, and even Li Xiaoxiao was all the remaining share after Meng Tian withheld it.
Just like Li Xiaoxiao, if she gains ten points of energy, then Dead Space will intercept 50% of the energy and gain five points of energy.
The remaining five points belong to Li Xiaoxiao.
And because she signed a contract with Meng Tian, ​​she will also share 50% with Meng Tian.
Li Xiaoxiao has 2.5 energy points and Meng Tian has 2.5 energy points.
In addition, Meng Tian will also charge corresponding fees for establishing company rules, strengthening the body, trading, etc.
Among them, apart from strengthening the body, which acts on itself and unlocks the huge spiritual power, the rest essentially acts on the dead space.
Well, as an employee of Dead Space, how can we not contribute 90% to Dead Space?
If he were an employee of Li Xiaoxiao's company, he would be divided into 50% by the company, which would be even worse than Li Xiaoxiao's.
But…
Compared with such a huge opportunity as entering the dead space, what is the little energy spent?
Well, that's it!
Meng Tianda nodded.
Of course, Li Xiaoxiao didn't know all of this. She could only see what she had gained and what her employees would gain in the future.
In her eyes, the only loss is probably the handling fee.
At most, it is guessed that half of her income will be given to Meng Tian.
After all, she is also Meng Tian's employee.
Although it was not written in the contract, since Meng Tian was the one who led the contract, how could he not get any benefits?
Feeling the information in his mind, Li Xiaoxiao was silent for a long time, and finally slowly walked around the desk, sat down on the office chair, and sensed his own state.
Another mysterious message appears...
The levels of dead space are divided into five levels: d, c, b, a, and s. Between each large level, there are three smaller levels.
For example, level D is divided into levels d1, d2, and d3, and so on for the others.
And her current level is the lowest D1 level, with 2 points of energy.
Well, after she signed the contract and calmed down completely, her strength dropped a little again, and now she only has 2 points of energy left.
It is also her final energy limit.
After some tossing, she finally improved from one point of energy to two points.
When it reaches 4 points of energy, she is at D2 level, and above 11 points of energy, she is at C level.
In addition to her own energy, it is naturally the energy owned by the company.
Li Xiaoxiao stretched out his hand, and two cards appeared in his palm.
This is an energy card, an idea that Meng Tian had when he signed the contract with her.
If you want to trade energy, you naturally need a specific form of energy.
You can't just integrate it directly into your body or the company's location, right?
In this way, when trading, you still need to have personal contact, and then mobilize and transfer energy bit by bit.
Not only is it extremely troublesome, it may also bring personal mental imprints and distracting thoughts. If you absorb too much, it will inevitably lead to mixed power.
Even because it affects spiritual consciousness, it may lead to confusion, madness or schizophrenia.
After all, not everyone is like Meng Tian, ​​who has the Dead Space as a transit for refining.
And what he assimilated was only pure spiritual energy.
Therefore, Meng Tian prepared to use the energy gained through the transformation of the death space to wash away the emotional power and personal spiritual imprints belonging to others, and then distribute it to others.
As for the emotional power and personal spiritual imprints that remain in the dead space after being stripped away, they are not without use.
Just like Li Xiaoxiao's previous fear of the elevator, the little girl, the front desk, and even the Menggui Building and the entire death space, they will all be integrated into the corresponding existence.
This will allow them to give birth to some spiritual power belonging to the element of fear, which will create a kind of fear in the hearts of those who come after them.Deterrence, and then grab more spiritual power.
As for the pollution of dead space...
